        "All 118 owned diff lines were read. The Timer module import adds clearTimeout. _send starts or resets the command watchdog after an actual socket.send; its early non-open-socket return does not arm it. _onData first yields one event turn, then clears the timer before deciding whether the payload has a complete line. _cleanUp clears the timer to avoid a later callback after cleanup.",
        "The delay is (mailnews.tcptimeout, default 100, plus 10) * 1000 milliseconds. This is an added margin, not a verified proof that native socket and application timers cannot race. Receipt of any data, including an incomplete line, cancels this timer until another command sends. _onOpen does not start it while awaiting the initial greeting. Thus the source implements a sent-command first-data guard, not a whole-response, connection-establishment or general inactivity watchdog.",
        "On expiry, the callback calls asynchronous _actionDone(NS_ERROR_NET_TIMEOUT). Its done guard, UIDL write, QUIT and later three-second cleanup fallback precede _cleanUp's onFree callback. Pop3IncomingServer uses a static busy flag and waiter queue; the onFree closure clears that flag and resolves the next waiter. Normal source flow therefore explains the queue-release route, but the timer callback itself does not synchronously release the queue or promise release exactly three seconds after firing.",
